prompt: Original instrumental race music for a futuristic anti-gravity racing game: relentless hard rock at 172 BPM. Heavy distorted rhythm guitars chugging fast palm-muted riffs, a wild screaming lead guitar hook that repeats, a galloping bass, pounding live drums with double kick and crashing cymbals, short shredding guitar fills between phrases, a breakdown with a pinch-harmonic riff, then a faster final chorus with dual harmony leads. Raw, loud, aggressive, the feeling of flying at full speed. No vocals, no spoken words, no synth pads.
